public.text: The governance section requires understandable consent and a documented access policy, but does not address supported decision-making, changes in decision-making capacity, guardianship, disputes over authority, safeguarding against coercion or abuse, or the end of a delegation. These are governance questions that cannot safely be left to each application.
public.suggestedRevision: Expand consent and access governance to require rules for creating, verifying, reviewing, suspending and terminating representative authority; recording the legal or consensual basis; handling temporary and fluctuating capacity; resolving disputes; preventing coercion and misuse; providing user-visible logs and alerts; and offering accessible complaint and redress mechanisms.
